title: Sharp inequalities for Logarithmic Coefficients for Certain Classes of Univalent Functions
summary: Let $\mathcal{S}$ denote the class of functions $f(z) = z + \sum_{n=2}^{\infty} a_n z^n$ that are analytic and univalent in the open unit disk $\mathbb{D} = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : |z| < 1\}$. In this paper, we determine the sharp bounds of the Toeplitz determinants whose entries are the logarithmic coefficients of $f \in \mathcal{S}$. Furthermore, we investigate the corresponding Toeplitz determinants for the logarithmic coefficients of the associated inverse functions.
